frihet-io-frihet-mcp-clientes.description: Manage Frihet clients, contacts, notes and follow-up. Use for alta de cliente, actualizar cliente, CRM, contactos, seguimiento comercial or customer briefing. Verifies identity, avoids duplicate clients and keeps communication proposals separate from authorized record changes.

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-marketplace-openai-.description: Search clients by commercial name, prepare client meeting briefings, and manage Frihet client records, contacts, notes, and CRM activity timelines in ChatGPT. Use when the user asks to find or prepare for a meeting with a client, list or inspect clients, create or update a client, manage client contacts or notes, or review and log client CRM activities such as calls, emails, meetings, or tasks.

Manage Frihet client records, contacts, notes, and CRM activity timelines in ChatGPT. Use when the user asks to list or inspect clients, create or update a client, manage client contacts (list, add, delete), manage client notes (list, add, delete), or review and log client CRM activities such as calls, emails, meetings, or tasks (clientes, CRM, contactos, notas, actividades y seguimiento comercial).

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-cobros.description: Review pending and overdue invoices in a connected Frihet workspace. Use for cobros pendientes, impagos, morosos, antigüedad de saldos, enlaces de cobro, receivables or payment follow-up. Verifies partial payments and currencies, retrieves server-authoritative portal payment links when available, and drafts reminders.

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-claude-operational-.description: Review pending and overdue invoices in a connected Frihet workspace. Use for cobros pendientes, impagos, morosos, antigüedad de saldos, receivables or payment follow-up. Verifies partial payments and currencies, then drafts reminders.

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-documentos.description: Prepare invoices and quotes for a connected Frihet workspace. Use for preparar factura, presupuesto, invoice draft, quote or quote conversion. Resolves missing client, currency and tax data before an authorized draft creation. Also use for invoice recovery after timeout, lost response or resultado desconocido al crear.

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-marketplace-openai-.description: List, inspect, record, and update business expenses and search, inspect, create, or update vendor/supplier records in a connected Frihet workspace. Use when the user asks to review expenses by date or category, check an expense detail, record a new expense, update an expense's description/category/date/ deductibility, or search, list, view, create, or update vendors/suppliers (gastos, proveedores, buscar proveedor, registrar gasto).

List, inspect, record, and update business expenses and vendor records in a connected Frihet workspace. Use when the user asks to review expenses by date or category, check an expense detail, record a new expense, update an expense's description/category/date/deductibility, or list, view, create, or update vendors/suppliers (gastos, proveedores, registrar gasto, facturas recibidas).

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-root.description: Manage a connected Frihet ERP workspace: invoices, quotes, expenses, clients, products and other available business operations. Use for Frihet requests, facturas, presupuestos, gastos, cobros, overdue invoices, monthly review or revisión mensual. Reads current tool schemas before acting, separates currencies and prepares changes for approval. Requires a connected Frihet MCP server.
frihet-io-frihet-mcp-root.author: Frihet

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-claude-operational-.description: Manage a connected Frihet workspace: invoices, quotes, expenses, clients, products and other available business operations. Use for Frihet requests, facturas, presupuestos, gastos, cobros, overdue invoices, monthly review or revisión mensual. Reads current tool schemas before acting, separates currencies and prepares changes for approval. Requires a connected Frihet MCP server.
frihet-io-frihet-mcp-claude-operational-.author: Frihet

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-marketplace-openai-.description: Onboard, orient, and review a connected Frihet workspace, daily operational priorities, month-over-month period comparisons, and the product and service catalogue in ChatGPT. Use after installing the plugin (onboarding and setup), when the user asks what deserves attention today, compares monthly business periods, requests a workspace overview, checks plan usage or defaults, or lists, inspects, creates, or updates catalogue products and services.

Onboard, orient, and review a connected Frihet workspace and its product and service catalogue in ChatGPT. Use after installing the plugin (onboarding and setup), or when the user asks what Frihet can do, requests a workspace or monthly business overview, checks plan usage or workspace defaults, or lists, inspects, creates, or updates catalogue products and services (resumen del negocio, contexto de la empresa, catálogo de productos y servicios).

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-gastos.description: Review and record expenses and vendors in Frihet. Use for registrar gasto, revisar gastos, proveedores, gastos duplicados, expense entry or supplier review. Distinguishes a proposed expense from an authorized saved record.

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-marketplace-openai-.description: Search, inspect, and prepare numbered invoice drafts and quote drafts, or delete/cancel quotes in a connected Frihet workspace. Use when the user asks to list, search, or read invoices or quotes, check draft or overdue invoices, prepare or create an invoice or quote draft, or delete/cancel a quote (facturas, presupuestos, borradores de factura, buscar facturas).

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-operaciones.description: Work with Frihet team, time tracking, leave, POS, kitchen and hospitality records. Use for equipo, vacaciones, fichajes, partes de horas, TPV, cocina, alojamientos or operational review. Discovers available actions and verifies scope before changing employee or operational records.

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-revision-mensual.description: Review a month's business records in a connected Frihet workspace. Use for revisión mensual, cierre mensual, monthly review, month summary or resumen del mes. Separates billed, collected and outstanding amounts by currency and reports gaps without claiming accounting or fiscal close.

frihet-io-frihet-mcp-tesoreria.description: Review bank accounts, transactions and reconciliation in Frihet. Use for conciliación bancaria, movimientos, tesorería, bank transactions or cash review. Proposes matches and records only explicitly authorized links; never transfers funds or infers collection from an invoice status.
